description: Dedicated HGRApi tool for POST api/ListingCreate/Submit. This is an explicit tool with a fixed endpoint; it is not a generic endpoint caller. HGRApi functional documentation: Purpose: Submits a manually prepared listing for creation. ownerAgent: publication. Use when: Use only after manual listing creation data has already been prepared and the user wants to create or queue that exact listing. Input: [FromBody] rq: SubmitCreateRequest, compatible with CreateRequest. Variation Markup settings are rounded to the nearest integer, with midpoint values rounded away from zero. Non-finite, malformed or out-of-range Markup values are ignored without deleting an existing override. For eBay API only, a missing VAT variation setting is initialized from the saved draft VAT or the store's PublishVAT default. Explicit product VAT, including zero, is preserved. VAT must be an integer from 0 to 100. UserDevice is optional HGRWeb client telemetry; AI chat and MCP must omit it and must not invent a device value. Output: Creates the listing through ListingService and returns success. Search terms: listingcreate submit. Send the exact request payload in body. Requires confirmed=true and impactConfirmed=true before execution. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally. Internal-only request fields are removed automatically before the HGRApi request is sent.

body.description: HGRApi POST /api/ListingCreate/Submit request body. Internal-only request fields are removed automatically.

channelOAuthId.description: ChannelOAuthId returned by hgr_list_channels for the selected visible store.

confirmed.description: Must be true after the user explicitly requested or confirmed the exact action.

impactConfirmed.description: Must be true after the user explicitly confirmed the concrete high-impact consequences.
